# Anne Shirley & Marilla Cuthbert

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Child of — [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) — adoptive mother · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P16](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P89](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0089), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P16](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0016)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is shocked when [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) arrives home with a girl instead of the expected boy, causing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to burst into tears upon realizing she is unwanted. After a quiet supper where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is too heartbroken to eat, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) puts her to bed in the east gable room. Downstairs, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) suggests keeping [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to help her, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) insists she must be returned to the asylum.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), marvels at the beautiful scenery, and eats a quiet breakfast with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). She helps [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) with the household chores and gives names to the bedroom cherry tree and a geranium. After dinner, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) set off in the buggy for [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to resolve Anne's placement with Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P1](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P19](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P27](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P42](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0042)_

> During their drive along the shore road, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to share the facts of her life. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recounts her upbringing as an orphan who worked for Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) and Mrs. [Hammond](../character/hammond.md) before being sent to the asylum, causing [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to feel pity for her hard life.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER V. Anne’s History

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER V. > [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visit Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) to address the mix-up regarding Anne's adoption. When the harsh Mrs. [Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md) offers to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a servant, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hesitates and decides to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home first. Later at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) to keep [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and adopt her.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P18](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER VI. > [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) up to bed and instructs her to fold her clothes and say her prayers. Discovering [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has never prayed before, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) has her improvise a prayer at her knee, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ends like a letter. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) then goes downstairs to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), resolved to teach [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) proper religious and practical manners.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P1](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P13](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER VII. > [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) have decided to let her stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), sending [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) into tears of joy. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) then instructs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to memorize the Lord's Prayer, though Anne's vivid imagination repeatedly distracts her until [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sends her up to her gable room.
>

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and insults Anne's looks, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to fly into a furious rage and yell at her. After an offended Mrs. Rachel departs, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her bedroom and orders her to stay in her room until she agrees to apologize.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. > [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and persuades her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can come out of isolation. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) agrees and delivers a dramatic, melodramatic apology that completely appeases Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md). On the walk home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) expresses her joy at having a real home, touching Marilla's heart.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) shows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) three plain new dresses she has made for her, disappointing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) who longs for fashionable puffed sleeves. The following day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends Sunday school alone in her plain clothes decorated with wild flowers and finds the experience dull, especially compared to the other girls in puffed sleeves. Upon returning home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) a candid report of the day's events and services.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her decorated hat before taking her to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). In the garden, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) become instant friends and swear a solemn oath of friendship. Returning home happily, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a treat of chocolates from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits to herself that she is becoming fond of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rushes inside after staying out late talking with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and eagerly asks [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) for permission to attend the upcoming Sunday-school picnic. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees and offers to bake a basket for her, which prompts a delighted embrace from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks incessantly about her playhouse with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and her intense excitement for the picnic, while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) worries [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sets her heart too much on things.
>

> When Marilla's amethyst brooch goes missing, she accuses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and confines her to her room until she confesses. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invents a dramatic story of losing it so she can attend the picnic, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forbids her from going anyway. Soon after, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the brooch caught in her shawl, apologizes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and sends her off to enjoy the picnic after all.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits her mistake regarding the brooch and forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), allowing her to attend the picnic after all. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns from the picnic overjoyed and describes her wonderful day to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who later admits to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) that she was wrong to force the confession.
>

> After being publicly humiliated and forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to return to school. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she calms down. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is overcome with laughter when she finds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping hysterically over the imaginary future scenario of [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) getting married.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invites [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) over for afternoon tea while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is away, but mistakenly serves her three glasses of homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) becomes sick and dizzy and has to go home, leading Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) to forbid [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) from playing with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ever again.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) explains to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) believes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) got [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk and forbidden their friendship. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally served currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, but after visiting Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) fails to change her mind. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to plead with Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) directly, but is turned away, leaving her heartbroken.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a dramatic goodbye after Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) forbids them from playing together. Unhappy with the separation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where her classmates welcome her warmly and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) sends her a secret note. Over the term, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) focuses fiercely on her studies and engages in an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel attend a political rally in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes in seeking help for [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), who has severe croup while her parents are away. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) uses her past experience with children to treat [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), saving her life, which leads Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) to forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and allow her and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to be best friends once again.
>

> After discussing her latest blunder with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize directly to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping onto her bed. Her honest confession and imaginative explanations charm Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) into staying in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and continuing Diana's music lessons.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her year at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and her outings with school friends. When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sends her to the Barrys' house at dusk, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confesses that she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) imagined the spruce grove was a [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forces a terrified [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk through the woods anyway to cure her of imagining ghosts.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bids farewell to Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) on the last day of school and later shares her excitement about the new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. After preparing extensively for the [Allans](../character/allan.md) to come to tea at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bakes a special layer cake, but Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notice something strangely wrong with it upon tasting it.
>

> During tea with the minister and his wife, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally serves a cake flavored with liniment instead of vanilla. Mortified by her mistake, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flees to her room in tears, but Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) kindly comforts her and assures her it was an honest mistake.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns from the post office thrilled to have received a written invitation to tea at the manse from Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md). Despite her anxiety about proper etiquette and Matthew's weather forecast, she attends the tea and returns home delighted. Sitting with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) happily recounts her wonderful evening, including news about singing in the choir and [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) hiring a new female teacher.
>

> During a game of dares at Diana's party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof and falls, breaking her ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) carries her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), making [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realize how deeply she loves the girl. During her seven weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives many visitors and eagerly anticipates returning to school under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and thrives under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically talks to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) about her schoolwork and field trips, though [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains critical. Later, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) proposes organizing a Christmas concert to raise money for a school flag, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) embraces wholeheartedly despite Marilla's skepticism and Matthew's encouraging support.
>

> Noticing how plain Anne's clothes are compared to other girls', [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) tries to buy her a trendy puffed-sleeve dress at a [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) shop, but gets so intimidated by the clerk that he ends up buying rakes, seed, and sugar instead. He enlists Mrs. Lynde's help to buy and sew the fashionable brown dress, which he presents to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on a snowy Christmas morning alongside a pair of slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed by the gifts and goes on to star in the successful [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Christmas concert.
>

> On Christmas morning, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a pair of kid slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) for the concert. The evening concert is a huge success, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) performing wonderfully in her new dress. Afterward, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) discuss how proud they are of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and consider her future education.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) turns thirteen and talks with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) along the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) about growing up, writing compositions, and forming a story club for practice. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses the story club's progress and moral lessons with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who tells her to finish washing the dishes.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comes home to find tea not prepared and learns that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dyed her hair green using dye bought from a peddler. When washing fails to remove the dye, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) has to cut Anne's hair off short. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school with her hair shingled, bearing the humiliation as penance.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends re-enact [Elaine](../character/elaine.md) on a leaky flat boat, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stranded on a bridge pile when the boat sinks. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescues her in a dory, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) coldly rejects his attempt to apologize and become friends. Back home, after discussing the day's lesson on avoiding over-romanticism with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) quietly encourages [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to keep a little romance.
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) invites [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to visit [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). After getting permission, the girls spend a delightful week attending the fair, visiting the park, and seeing a concert before returning home.
>

> [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) bids farewell to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), reflecting fondly on how Anne's presence brought life into her home. The girls enjoy a scenic drive back to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a warm welcome and a special dinner from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing an extra class to prepare advanced students for Queen's entrance examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) join, which delights her. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joins her classmates in the new study group, though she regrets Diana's absence and finds herself missing Gilbert's attention despite their fierce academic rivalry.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) secretly regrets her ongoing feud with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), though the two remain intense academic rivals. Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return to teach next year, relieved students pack away their studies, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to enjoy her summer before growing up. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), expressing her relief over Matthew's health and admitting to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has matured.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a restful summer outdoors before returning to her studies, discussing her growing maturity and moral thoughts with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). As the Queen's class prepares for the fateful [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations under Miss Stacy's guidance, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices Anne's rapid physical growth and quiet demeanor, sharing her fears of losing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) and returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to anxiously await the results. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings news that the pass list is out and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has tied for first place on the Island with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her joyful success with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), concluding the evening with a peaceful visit to Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md).
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress for her recital at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) pops in to offer her own proud yet gruff commentary. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rides to the hotel with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Billy](../character/billy.md), where she experiences severe stage fright before performing. After catching sight of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds her courage, gives an outstanding performance that earns an encore, and enjoys the post-concert reception.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) with help from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), who buy her a green evening dress. After moving to town, she attends her first day at the [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and their [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) classmates, only to face intense homesickness in her boarding house until [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and Ruby visit.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns she has won the Avery scholarship while [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal. After graduating, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where she notices Matthew's failing health and learns about potential financial trouble with the Abbey Bank. [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) lovingly tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) he is prouder of her than he would be of a dozen boys.
>

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) collapses and dies suddenly after reading news of the bank failure. The household and community mourn his death, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) express their deep love for each other in their shared grief. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about coping with sorrow and moving forward.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learns from an oculist that her eyesight is failing, prompting her to consider selling [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to let the home be sold, revealing her decision to forgo her college scholarship and remain in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to teach and care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) later informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school position for her, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reconcile with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and become close friends with him.
>

> Anne's peaceful afternoon reading [Virgil](../codex/tech.md#virgil) is interrupted by her angry neighbor, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who confronts her after her cow strays into his oats field. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home and discusses the incident and family matters with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), after which Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) arrives and shares local gossip about incoming residents.
>

> Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Stephen Irving's son coming to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). The conversation shifts to Anne's plans to form a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), which Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) cautions against, and the news that Anne's friend [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) will be teaching at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody).
>
> — v2 · I An Irate Neighbor

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P50](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0050), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P54](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0054), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057)_

> On their way back from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discover a Jersey cow in Mr. Harrison's oat field. Believing it to be her own unruly cow [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) impetuously sells the animal on the spot to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md). Upon returning home, she discovers [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) safe in her pen and realizes in horror that she has mistakenly sold Mr. Harrison's cow.
>
> — v2 · II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure

_Sources: [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P24](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0024), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P28](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0028), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P35](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0035)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to confess that she accidentally sold his cow, offering her own cow in exchange. Despite initial squabbling and insults from his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) accepts her apology, trades cows, and invites [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to share a cake and tea with him. They become friends, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to happily share the good outcome with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>

> On the eve of beginning their teaching jobs, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) debate whether corporal punishment is ever necessary in school. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) speaks with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also scoffs at her ideal of governing pupils purely through affection. The next morning, a anxious [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) drinks ginger tea prepared by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) before setting off to school.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) begins her first day teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, observing her new pupils and feeling a special connection with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). After school, an eccentric parent, Mrs. Donnell, confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about how her children's names are pronounced and used. Returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her experience with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), remaining determined to win over the sullen [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive around canvassing their assigned road to raise money for painting the hall on behalf of the newly formed [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). They encounter various eccentric neighbors, including grim Miss Eliza, her optimistic sister Catherine, a stressed husband in an apron, and an overly neat Mrs. White.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) chat about their teaching experiences and future ambitions. After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home and discusses taking in the Keith twins due to their mother's failing health, which she ultimately agrees to do with Anne's encouragement.
>

> At supper, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) acts rambunctiously and snatches Dora's cake, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to try teaching him gentlemanly manners. After supper, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sends [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed early in the west gable room while she takes [Dora](../character/dora.md) to sleep with her.
>

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he put a toad in Marilla's bed. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hurriedly removes the toad using a fire shovel before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) can discover it, then notices [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) signaling from her window.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and the hall painting project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before leaving for home. Shortly after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) finishes painting the hall, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers it has been painted bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint numbers. [The Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) are initially devastated, but the rest of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) rallies in sympathy and support for them against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).
>

> After walking home through [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to discover that [Dora](../character/dora.md) is missing and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) claims not to know where she is. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse and realizes [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) lied about it. When confronted, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) tearfully promises never to tell another lie after learning it is wrong, though he later argues to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in bed that [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) also lied to him about prayers.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lectures [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) about how lying was the dreadful consequence of him stopping his prayers. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes downstairs and shares the story with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), leading to a conversation about Davy's behavior, schooling, and why they find themselves fond of him despite his mischief.
>

> In a detailed letter to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) describes her experiences and humorous anecdotes from teaching her pupils. She shares various amusing classroom incidents and transcripts of letters written by her students, concluding with a imaginative composition by her favorite pupil, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md).
>

> Suffering from a toothache and a frustrating day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly orders a pupil to throw a package into the school stove, causing an explosion of firecrackers. Later, when [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) plays a prank on her with a mouse, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) loses her temper and whips him. Though distraught over her loss of self-control, she discovers the next morning that the punishment earned Anthony's respect.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) converses with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) about Marilla's improving eyesight and the upcoming [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) bazaar, then returns home to learn that [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) will remain with them through the fall. She recalls disciplining [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) for eating forbidden jam, after which she attends an Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting where [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) alerts everyone to Judson Parker's plan to rent his fence for advertisements. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) attempt to talk Judson out of it, but he refuses to change his mind.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) is coming to visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), and she eagerly plans a elaborate dinner for the occasion. She spends the following days busy with preparations and keeping the children in line for the big event.
>
> — v2 · XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For

Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) fails to arrive, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) heartbroken until a letter reveals Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle.
>

> After the guests leave and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) goes home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) stating that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will not be visiting. Sitting on the porch at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss life's disappointments, how to resolve the broken platter, local gossip, and Anne's plan to take the twins on a shore picnic.
>

> After a conversation with [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) sets off with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) to search for a replacement willow-ware platter. Their search leads them to the Copp house on [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road), where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gets stuck after crashing through the roof of a duckhouse while peering through the pantry window. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) stays with her through a rainstorm until Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp returns home, frees [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with an axe, and agrees to host tea and discuss selling her platter.
>

[Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discuss the progress and upcoming initiatives of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) as well as the return of their school teaching friends. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to discuss her busy plan of chores for the following day with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>

> Before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) leaves for town with [Dora](../character/dora.md), she and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talk with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) about behaving well. Left alone to do chores, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally dyes her nose red with rug dye instead of applying freckle lotion, right as [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) save the day by bringing chicken for dinner, and the guests enjoy a delightful meal and a walk through the woods before departing.
>

> School resumes, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) deal with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and Dora's first days and Mirabel Cotton's ghost stories. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) get lost on their way to a tea party and discover [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they are invited to stay for tea by the eccentric Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md).
>

> At the breakfast table, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's visit with Miss Lavendar, as well as the history of [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) Lynde's family, while trying to manage Davy's poor table manners. A month later, news arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has died, leaving a trust fund for [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) so they can permanently stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>

> After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) publish a mock newspaper note about Uncle Abe's weather predictions, a severe severe hailstorm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on the exact predicted day, causing massive devastation to crops, trees, and windows. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) weather the storm at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the twins, later learning of the damage around town, including the death of Mr. Harrison's parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md).
>
> — v2 · XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P3](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0003), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers that Mr. Harrison's wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), has unexpectedly arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to reunite with him. The news quickly spreads through the neighborhood and school, leading Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to step in and assist [Emily](../character/emily.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) at his newly cleaned home, where he prepares to explain the backstory of his marriage.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P28](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P43](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0043), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P55](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0055)_

> Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) how he and his wife [Emily](../character/emily.md) originally separated over domestic habits and his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) before reconciling. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays to eat tea with the Harrisons, walks back across the fields with [Emily](../character/emily.md), and later puts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) while conversing with [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P56](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0056), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P60](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0060), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's death, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can leave to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resigns from her teaching position, which causes great sorrow among her students and her friend [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), even as she prepares for her new journey.
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_

> At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) dinner, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) chatted with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), school pranks, and marriage until [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) laughed herself out to the cellar hatch. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walked to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss Lavendar and Charlotta the Fourth, enjoying lunch, playing with echoes, and gathering wild strawberries.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P35](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0035)_

> As preparations for Miss Lavendar's wedding get underway, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses the romantic turn of events with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), Charlotta the Fourth, and a skeptical [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally discovers that [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) are in love, leading [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide her engagement details to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
